reason: Host-apply the T9 re-review's single remaining finding (both quality+security, delegate cannot convey findings): the global-exception filter's error log record writes request.path UNMASKED, bypassing the masking added to the middleware's request record - so a client-controlled path (email/account-id/token, incl. on a 404) persists in structured logs, leaving t9-c2 partial. Export the maskPath helper from request-logging.middleware and reuse it for the filter's error-record path so both records mask identically.
